prompt:
Subject: anode, target meaning "陽極".

Composition: Show a clean copper electroplating setup: a copper source plate and a metal spoon hang in blue solution connected to a power supply. Emphasize the dissolving copper anode feeding the coating on the spoon, without symbols.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. A copper plate and metal spoon hang in blue electroplating solution connected to a power supply; copper dissolves from the anode and coats the spoon.
en: Copper dissolves from the anode and coats the spoon.
ja: 陽極の銅が溶け出し、スプーンに銅が付着しています。
